# VS Code / Copilot repository adapter

The canonical, IDE-agnostic instructions for this repository are in the root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read and follow that file before making changes.

Portable workflow skills are in [`skills/`](../skills/). The current host may expose them as slash commands, agent skills, or plain Markdown playbooks. Use the workflow content that the host supports, and do not claim multi-agent or multi-model execution unless the host actually performed it.
